title: Swaprun
description: Speedrun, where everybody swap every minute!
body:
Did you wanted to try speedrun with you friends? But there's a twist.

So, I was inspired by [Sapnap's video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GwrAvYlT7xg). ! It's not the same plugin ! I decided to recreate it myself as I didn't find it anywhere to try it. Tested like 3 times and it just worked.

All commands (prefix can be /swaprun or just /sr):
- /swaprun start -> start the game
- /swaprun stop -> stop the game
- /swaprun join -> join the queue
- /swaprun leave -> leave the queue
- /swaprun add -> manually add another player
- /swaprun randomize -> randomly change the players in queue
- /swaprun reload -> reloads the plugin
- /swaprun setwaitingarea -> change waiting area, where should all players waiting for turn to stay. By default, there's no need to change it.
- /swaprun queue -> show how and which players are in queue

Commands start, stop, add, randomize, reload & setwaitingarea requiring OP or swaprun.admin permission.

So, do you want to take the challenge?
